title: Check the validity of a class's metaclass.
summary: Mypy checks whether the metaclass of a class is valid. The metaclass must be a subclass of type. mypy enables this error code by default.

title: Check that assignment target is not a method.
summary: In general, assigning to a method on class object or instance (a.k.a. monkey-patching) is ambiguous in terms of types, since Python's static type system cannot express the difference between bound and unbound callable types. mypy enables this error code by default.
